real_yield.methodology: Use an official inflation-linked 10Y constant-maturity yield where the issuer publishes a daily, reproducible series; do not infer by subtracting CPI from nominal yield.
real_yield.activation_blocker: No cross-country official, same-tenor source registry and PIT receipts.

breakeven.methodology: Use nominal 10Y minus matched official real 10Y only when both are same-currency, same-tenor and same-session; label as market-implied breakeven.
breakeven.activation_blocker: Depends on certified matched nominal/real source pairs and PIT alignment.

term_premium.methodology: Use a named published model only (for example a central-bank published ACM-style estimate); never back out residuals from the dashboard curve.
term_premium.activation_blocker: No homogeneous official/published model registry, vintage policy or historical PIT archive.

fiscal_supply.methodology: Context-only issuer supply/fiscal indicator from official debt-management and fiscal releases; it must not be treated as a decomposed yield component or assigned a causal sign mechanically.
fiscal_supply.activation_blocker: No cross-country release calendar, definitions harmonisation or PIT source registry.
